title: Git Flow برای release و hotfix
description: قالب GitGraph قابل ویرایش برای feature، develop، release، tag نسخه و hotfix.
keywords: GitGraph Mermaid قالب Git Flow branching strategy release hotfix نمودار شاخه گیت
code:
gitGraph LR:
  commit id: "v1.3.0" tag: "v1.3.0"
  branch develop
  commit id: "prepare-1.4"
  branch feature-auth
  commit id: "auth-ui"
  commit id: "auth-api"
  checkout develop
  merge feature-auth id: "merge-auth"
  branch release-1.4
  commit id: "release-qa"
  checkout main
  merge release-1.4 id: "release-1.4" tag: "v1.4.0"
  checkout develop
  merge release-1.4 id: "sync-1.4"
  checkout main
  branch hotfix-payment
  commit id: "payment-fix" type: HIGHLIGHT
  checkout main
  merge hotfix-payment id: "hotfix-1.4.1" tag: "v1.4.1"
  checkout develop
  merge hotfix-payment id: "sync-hotfix"
